campaign: R29: propagate the frozen design C, calibrate its budget grid, and run the archived budget ladder on it

parent.inherited: the outcomes H/I/J, the single-draw commitment, the seed rule and the scope statement of R26 are carried unchanged; this record adds only the steps R26 left unwritten

not_blind: designs A and B are already propagated and their tallies are known. The protection is the single-draw commitment of R26 and the verdict rule below, both fixed before any design-C budget number exists.

base.produces: r26_designC_rows.json (prepass) and r26_designC_convergence.json with the truth trajectories and the critical-degree comparator at both tolerance levels
base.unchanged: the prepass and convergence drivers are the ones that produced design B, pointed at design C

operating_point.why: rev14_budget_pareto.worker reads the archived R12 accuracy-target configuration of every orbit. Design C has no R12 campaign, so the operating point is regenerated by the R12 rule: tol = actual worst-case acceleration truncation error of N_crit against the adopted truth at perilune, the 10-km binned Atallah schedule from that tol, and N_work = round(sqrt(<N^2>)) of the tight Atallah RHS history
operating_point.writes_where: metrics/r29_cases/atallah_designC, a new tree; no R12 artifact is created, moved or touched, so the R12 manifest partition is unaffected

reproduction_check.what: the same generator is run on a subsample of designs A and B and compared against their archived R12 configurations
reproduction_check.gate: tol and the binned degree table are pure functions of the design point and must reproduce exactly, or no design-C operating point is written
reproduction_check.reported_not_gated: N_work comes from propagation telemetry and the archived R12 campaign ran under a different interpreter; any disagreement is reported per orbit rather than silently accepted or hidden

calibration.extra_budget_status: post hoc, inherited from r28_calibration_amendment.json (4d8a78eb43604971); it is reported flagged as not pre-registered wherever it appears, exactly as the design A and B midpoints are
calibration.archive_untouched: r14_budget_pareto.json is verified byte-identical before and after; design C is never merged into it
calibration.admissibility: the same pass recomputes the whole frozen grid for designs A and B and requires exact equality with the archived calibration on every orbit and every budget. If any scalar differs, no design-C calibration is written.

ladder.modification: none. The drivers are sha256-pinned in sealed manifests and are called through a wrapper that registers design C in their design table and points build_specs at the design-C calibration record.
ladder.order_rationale: 0.75 and 0.50 are the two budgets that bracket the crossing on designs A and B, so they are propagated first: a campaign that runs out of time still answers the question it was opened for. 1.00 replicates the headline budget, 0.62 the declared midpoint, and the rest extend the curve.

verdict_rule.per_budget: from r19_equal_total_work_C_beta_*.json: interior if resolved_interior_wins > resolved_fixed_wins, constant if resolved_fixed_wins > resolved_interior_wins, split if equal
verdict_rule.bracket: the crossing bracket of a design is (largest grid budget with a constant verdict, smallest grid budget with an interior verdict], over the grid budgets that design has propagated
verdict_rule.H_requires: design C returns a constant verdict at beta = 0.50 and an interior verdict at beta = 0.75
verdict_rule.I_requires: any other resolved pair of verdicts at those budgets
verdict_rule.J_requires: either budget resolves too few comparisons to produce a verdict, or the base is incomplete
verdict_rule.not_deciding: the median error ratio and its distance from unity are recorded as a secondary signature and do not enter the verdict, which is the tally rule the campaign has used since R19
verdict_rule.no_averaging: if design C disagrees, the three designs are reported side by side; no pooled or averaged bracket is quoted

completion_reporting: every quoted design-C number carries its completion count. A budget whose ladder is partially propagated is reported as partial or not reported, never completed by inference.
prohibited: dropping an orbit of design C after its numbers are known
editing any rev*.py that a sealed manifest hashes
quoting a design-C budget whose base is incomplete
presenting beta = 0.62 as a pre-registered budget on any design
